organizations.publicNote: Recording label within the Lindström group. Export issues used the spelling Parlophone; the label is kept distinct from the corporate body Carl Lindström AG.
House name used on Parlophone issues, which does not identify the players.

sources.fullCitation: Orchestra Mascotte. “Moonlight at Sanssouci.” Waltz; label credit “Rotter–Kaper”. Parlophone A3436, matrix Be 9615, n.d. Australian pressing, labelled “Made in Australia for Parlophone Co. Ltd.” Disc label photograph and digital transfer published by the Great 78 Project, Internet Archive.
sources.title: Moonlight at Sanssouci — Parlophone A3436
sources.creator: Orchestra Mascotte
sources.researchNote: The Internet Archive item includes a photograph of the disc, not audio alone. The label identifies Orchestra Mascotte, Parlophone A3436 and Australia; the runout shows Be 9615, also transcribed in the item metadata. The patent dates printed around the label rim are not recording or issue dates. No independently documented issue date has been established for this Australian pressing; dates assigned to other Parlophone issues are not transferred to A3436. Orchestra Mascotte is a house name and does not identify the individual players.
